So what combo’s of heroes, or villains and envirments have you found so far? Mine:

Fanatic + Bunker: he has some ongoings that really pour red hot damage on your foes, and with Fanatic emboldening him and providing support it becomes a really potnent mix.

Villain:

Grand Warlord Voss in Rook City. REALLY big mistake. The city has cards that reduces damage to villain targets and that plays villain cards… so his minions started to really get out of control very quickly. We ended up conceeding when he had every minion come back from the graveyard for the second time… it may have been 10 (auto loss) but we did not even check, we knew we where done.

If you haven’t tried it, yet, go with Legacy, Ra, and Absolute Zero. You can add any other heroes you want - say Visionary to help AZ go off faster - but these three really make fun stuff happen. Legacy builds everything the other two do, Ra throws everything at AZ (once he’s set up), and AZ throws all that back at the opponents - and then some.

It’s a fun, crazy combination - if you enjoy that kind of thing. 8)

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
The Wraith and Mr. Fixer.

When incapacitated, The Wraith can enable another hero to play a card. Mr. Fixer’s Overdrive card reads:

You may use Mr. Fixer’s “Strike” power twice this turn.

In a game we played this evening, Mr. Fixer’s ability to play that card on another hero’s turn enabled him to do 9 points of damage twice to the villain: Strike (1), Dual Crowbars (+1), Grease Monkey Fist (+1), Harmony (+1), Bloody Knuckles (+2), Legacy’s Galvanize power (+1), Legacy’s Inspirational Presence (+1), and a power from one of the Infernal Relics Heroes (+1). If there’d been another target available, using Dual Crowbars he could have done another 18 points of damage to another target.

As it happened, due to a card in an Infernal Relics environment, Mr. Fixer was also able to play two cards on his turn, getting out both a second Bloody Knuckles and a second Overdrive to do 36 points of damage on his turn, for a total of 54 points of damage in less than a round. But I digress.

In the other direction, The Wraith LOVES Mr. Fixer’s Salvage Yard card, which pulls all hero equipment out every players’ trash and puts it back into their hands.

Bunker likes that even more. Put him in turret mode with the Omnicannon and then have Mr. Fixer give him a ton of cards to use on the cannon and other places.

posts.name: Koga
posts.cooked: Here's a killer combo we learned tonight. When playing vs Infinitor, since we didn't have enough damage the first turn we just weakened his manisfestations to take out next round. Unfortunately the Environment (Time Cataclysm) played Surprise Shopping Trip. Infinitor flipped and his targets lost the DR 1 that he gave on his front side, so now each time one of his cards entered play everything took 1 damage and his first play just happened to be something that also played the top card and that one also played the top card so that was 3 points of damage going to all the manifestations, some of them having already been weakened by us. This happened when we also had 2 Occular Swarms out. This was just the start of the 2nd round, he kept comboing off occular swarm and surprise shopping trip until there were 10 manifestations in the trash and a handful of one-shots that got discarded due to occular swarm. He even got the 3rd one out while the 2nd one was still alive. We lost about half our HP or so just that single round from getting pinged over and over and over.
